verified_interpretive_points: Recent Irish courts continue to treat the register as having the statutory conclusive effect specified by s.31, subject to the statutory rectification framework.
The courts distinguish the legal effect of a register entry from proof of the detailed terms of an underlying transfer or assignment.
A challenge to a registered entry generally requires the appropriate statutory/court route rather than an indirect attempt to look behind the folio in unrelated proceedings.
